set.body: PRD C-9 and X-1 through X-17 remain normative. Reconciled 2026-09-17: Trials, structural Relation, typed PairDesign, keyed cap-monotone sampling, directed/undirected PairwiseAnalysis, explicit failure-policy reductions and signed contrasts are implemented; relation truth tables and sampler mutants are delivered. RepetitionDesign now constructs same-participant, across-occasion matched/control designs over that machinery, with inspectable edges, finite-cap controls and rational/pinned-reference conformance. Remaining acceptance: surface decomposition and partial association, broad numerical parity, execution using relation join keys (the inspectable ADT alone is not a hash join), and shared within-pair scheduling. Preserve Mass/Intensity/Signed distinctions and descriptive model scope; no alternate workflow hierarchy or cell-wise inference. See docs/REPETITION_STUDIES.md and docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md. This epic remains open and unassigned; bounded work belongs to its children.
